title: Day 23 of building GTA 6 using claude
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Building a GTA online clone in voxel style where the world never sleeps and all the NPCs are AI agents. Everything is built by players using prompts. Prompt your own car. Prompt your own building. Prompt your own weapon. 

I know in 2026 most people already gave up on huge online worlds but I'm naive enough to keep working on it. Having too much fun with this.

Using claude code and codex for development. Generations are done with OpenAI, groq api. 

  
link: [https://flair-3d.fly.dev/admin](https://flair-3d.fly.dev/admin)

comments.author: reverendblueball
comments.body: This could be cool! I like the idea!

comments.author: Odd-Woodpecker-592
comments.body:
I'm a little old school and I still love large open worlds but I admit I haven't played a MMO in a while.  In fact my most recent addiction has been this minecraft style FPS called "War Broker".  I like it because it plays completely in the browser.

That being said, this seems like a really cool project!  I like the idea of being able to prompt for stuff in an open world.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: That’s amazing! Love the feedback. It’s my biggest struggle Right now to build something players actually want!

comments.author: Odd-Woodpecker-592
comments.body: Out of curiosity and forgive me if this sounds naive but why use claude code and codex?  I use claude code for all of my development these days and it seems capable of doing pretty much everything on it's own.  What is the advantage of using codex as well?

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Codex is wayyy faster. That’s the main reason. And I think sometimes it can help to get a second Option from an agent haha

comments.author: Wild_Yam_7088
comments.body: hows it going with getting the npcs to feel like a actual world? im told that is the actual hard part is getting persistent AI npcs to act right

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: It works insanely well! Worked on this over the last few days, if you want, give it a try. It's really nice. They really act like they are players with a role in the world, and you can communicate with them over voice!
